name: 08-scanned-fax-noise
description: A legible-but-ugly OCR'd fax: broken lines, repeated page headers, character substitutions. Buried in the noise is a real furosemide dose increase. Extraction must be exact despite the formatting — noise is never an excuse for a wrong medication fact.

contradictions.detail: Verified furosemide fact says 40 mg daily; document increases it to 80 mg every morning with documented rationale

mustNot: read the OCR'd dose as anything but 40 mg -> 80 mg (digit-for-letter substitutions are noise, not data)
miss the unarranged transport for the 08/18 visit — the member has no ride and lives alone, and transport application is still in progress
